description: Historic hiking route along Goat River, leads to Bowron Park and Barkerville.
directions: Take Hwy 16 approx 25 kms west of McBride to Goat River FSR. Proceed upstream to confluence of Milk River where trail starts.

stats.Activity Details: Wildlife Viewing, Viewing, Horseback Riding, Camping, Hiking
